free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0.00 a month: 100 lookups a month with location data and HTTPS and no support
free_tier.notes: Standard is USD 12.99 a month (USD 11.99 billed yearly) for 50,000 lookups, then USD 0.0010392 each; Business USD 59.99 for 500,000 with Bulk Lookups; Business Pro USD 99.99 for 2,000,000. An answer that errors is not counted.

per_object_cap.stated: one IP per request on the Free plan; Bulk Lookups are listed from the Business plan

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON or XML answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: GET http(s)://api.ipapi.com/api/{ip}?access_key={key} answers JSON or XML; a call without a key answers HTTP 401 with error code 101 missing_access_key
chaining: 100 lookups a month is a test allowance only; the paid plans from USD 12.99 a month are the working route. Bulk path: Bulk Lookups on Business, USD 59.99 a month, and above; none free. APILayer, the vendor, also sells ipstack, which has its own record.

limits.value: 100 lookups a month on the Free plan

binding_note: 100 lookups a month is exhausted first; no rate is stated.

identity_cost.detail: a sign-up with first name, last name, email, password and a billing address (address, postal code, country, city); no card number is asked on the free sign-up form

reliability_note: usage notices are sent at 75%, 90% and 100% of the monthly allowance; a call without a key answers HTTP 401 with error code 101
confidence_note: The pricing, FAQ, home and sign-up pages were quoted on 2026-11-02 and a keyless call answered HTTP 401; no keyed lookup was made, so the answers and any rate limit on the Free plan are unverified.
